The incumbent oversees administrative functions for the Ambulatory Float Pool and collaborates with operational managers to coordinate systemwide communication and process development for float staff. Key responsibilities include managing complex staff training schedules, overseeing the onboarding process, ensuring all employee compliance records are up to date, coordinating staffing assignments and coverage, monitoring employee performance and compliance with departmental standards, and providing ongoing coaching, performance management, and professional development support. This role directly supervises administrative staff to ensure accountability and the effective use of departmental resources.

Provide administrative oversight, coaching, and support within Ambulatory Float Pool operations. In addition to supervisory responsibilities, serve as a liaison between operational managers and staff to ensure coordination of clinical staffing and support needs. Work closely with the Director of Operations to improve operational efficiency, support staff development, and foster a productive and collaborative work en
vironment. Represent the department in meetings involving daily operations, implementation of system goals, and adherence to protocols.
Exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action
Formal education or specialized coursework in project management, data analytics, process improvement, workforce management, or healthcare operations
